reference.type: none: the user gives no deck, template or brand guideline
reference.notes: The look is the model's: a blank draft with every address open, a blank package at the page size it chooses, --chrome draw, no --reference.

brief: Three pages for a board pack on our ferry business, any look you think reads well on screen: revenue growth, the summary figures, revenue and passengers by route.

expected_behavior.statement: The agent makes a blank draft and answers every address itself, page size included, each with a why; no address is left to a default.
expected_behavior.check: Pass or fail: extract_style.py --blank; complete_guide.py writes the guide with core_open [] and still_open []; every completed value carries value_provenance model_choice.

expected_behavior.statement: No corpus figure is copied into the look as a default, and no other deck's look is borrowed without the user naming it.
expected_behavior.check: Read the completion's whys: each states a reason for this deck, never a corpus count as the value.

expected_behavior.statement: Every hard limit holds: fit, contrast, floors (nothing under 7pt), roles not literals, tie-outs, a valid package.
expected_behavior.check: Pass or fail: deck.build.json every page fit, contrast.violations empty, validate --render and validate --emit --guide pass; the routes table's total ties out (203.4, 1,358).

expected_behavior.statement: Nothing is compared with a reference: the report reads 'no reference' wherever it would.
expected_behavior.check: Pass or fail: judge.verdict, repetition.against_reference.*.verdict, slides[].title.length.*.verdict, source_lines.reference.habit, contrast.precedent_source and leakage.verdict read 'no reference'; no warning names a reference.

expected_behavior.statement: Every stated figure is computed (9.4% a year, $61.4m, 30%, 2.7 points).
expected_behavior.check: Pass or fail: a script that asserts each figure from the data; the build's --computed file is its output.

expected_behavior.statement: The final report says which look was chosen and why, what the user must supply, and every page's status.
